mapper.select: select DISTINCT '开放计划' planType,/*计划类型*/ fop.CASH_ID cashId,/*现金流代码*/ fop.OPEN_TYPE openType,/*开放类型*/ fop.OPEN_DATE_STR openDateStr,/*开放计划开始日*/ fop.OPEN_DATE_END openDateEnd,/*开放计划结束日*/ fop.OPEN_VDATE openVdate,/*起息日*/ fop.OPEN_MDATE openMdate,/*开放确认日*/ fop.OPEN_NDATE openNdate,/*净值日*/ foru.TRADEDAY_RULE traRule,/*营业日准则*/ fp.CALENDAR_ID calendarId /*交易日历*/ from FIN_OPEN_PLAN fop inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = fop.FINPROD_ID and fp.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' left join FIN_OPEN_RULE foru on foru.CASH_ID = fop.CASH_ID where fop.OPEN_DATE_STR > to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') order by fop.CASH_ID

select distinct '分红/付息计划' planType,/*计划类型*/ fcp.CASH_ID cashId,/*现金流代码*/ fcp.VDATE_UNADJUST vdateUnadjust,/*未调整的计算开始日*/ fcp.MDATE_UNADJUST mdateUnadjust,/*未调整的计算结束日*/ fcp.PAY_DATE_UNADJUST payDateUnadjust,/*未调整的计划支付日*/ fcp.VDATE vdate,/*计息区间开始日*/ fcp.MDATE mdate,/*计息区间结束日*/ fcp.PAY_DATE payDate, /*支付日*/ fcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule,/*支付日营业日准则*/ fcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule,/*截止日营业日准则*/ fp.CALENDAR_ID calendarId /*交易日历*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp inner join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fci.CASH_ID = fcp.CASH_ID and fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' and fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE fcpr on fcpr.CASH_ID = fcp.CASH_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = fcp.FINPROD_ID and fp.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' where fcp.VDATE > to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') order by fcp.CASH_ID

select distinct '付费计划' planType,/*计划类型*/ fcp.CASH_ID cashId,/*现金流代码*/ fcp.VDATE_UNADJUST vdateUnadjust,/*未调整的计算开始日*/ fcp.MDATE_UNADJUST mdateUnadjust,/*未调整的计算结束日*/ fcp.PAY_DATE_UNADJUST payDateUnadjust,/*未调整的计划支付日*/ fcp.VDATE vdate,/*付费开始日*/ fcp.MDATE mdate,/*付费结束日*/ fcp.PAY_DATE payDate, /*支付日*/ fcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule,/*付费营业日准则*/ fcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule,/*计提营业日准则*/ fp.CALENDAR_ID calendarId /*交易日历*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp inner join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fci.CASH_ID = fcp.CASH_ID and fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = '03' left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE fcpr on fcpr.CASH_ID = fcp.CASH_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = fcp.FINPROD_ID and fp.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' where fcp.VDATE > to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') order by fcp.CASH_ID

select distinct '业绩报酬计提计划' planType,/*计划类型*/ fas.CASH_ID cashId,/*现金流代码*/ fas.ACCR_DATE accrDate,/*计提日*/ fas.ACCR_STR_DATE accrStrDate,/*区间开始日*/ fas.ACCR_END_DATE accrEndDate,/*区间结束日*/ fas.VAL_DATE valDate, /*调整前结束日*/ foru.TRADEDAY_RULE accrTadyRule, /*营业日准则*/ fp.CALENDAR_ID calendarId/*交易日历*/ from FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE fas left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fci.CASH_ID = fas.CASH_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = fci.FINPROD_ID and fp.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN fop ON fop.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE foru ON foru.CASH_ID =fop.CASH_ID where fas.ACCR_STR_DATE > to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') order by fas.CASH_ID

select distinct '回补计划' planType,/*计划类型*/ fas.CASH_ID cashId,/*现金流代码*/ fas.ACCR_DATE accrDate,/*回补日*/ fas.ACCR_STR_DATE accrStrDate,/*回补周期开始日*/ fas.ACCR_END_DATE accrEndDate,/*回补周期结束日*/ fas.VAL_DATE valDate, /*调整前结束日*/ foru.TRADEDAY_RULE accrTadyRule, /*营业日准则*/ fp.CALENDAR_ID calendarId/*交易日历*/ from FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE fas left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fci.CASH_ID = fas.CASH_ID and fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C11' inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = fci.FINPROD_ID and fp.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN fop ON fop.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE foru ON foru.CASH_ID =fop.CASH_ID where fas.ACCR_STR_DATE > to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') order by fas.CASH_ID

mapper.select: select TT.listN from ( select decode(t1.PROFIT_TYPE,'01',t.OPEN_NDATE,'03',t.OPEN_DATE_END) as listN from FIN_OPEN_PLAN t left join FIN_PRODUCT t1 on t1.FINPROD_ID=t.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_OPEN_RULE t2 on t2.CASH_ID=t.CASH_ID where t1.PROFIT_TYPE in('01','03') and t2.OPEN_MODE !='02' /*非高频开放*/ and t.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} )TT order by TT.listN

select DISTINCT t1.cash_id as cashId,t.vdate,t.mdate, t2.F_ACCR_DATE as provisionfirstday,t2.E_ACCR_DATE as eAccrDate from FIN_PRODUCT t left join FIN_CASH_INFO t1 on t1.finprod_id=t.finprod_id and t1.CASH_TYPE_2='C04' and t1.BRANCH = 0 left join FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE t2 on t2.cash_id=t1.cash_id where t.finprod_id=#{finprodId}

select t.mdate from ( SELECT decode(ps,'C7',mdate,'C9',trade_date) mdate, finprod_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY finprod_id ORDER BY decode(ps,'C7',mdate,'C9',trade_date) DESC ) ro FROM trd_fin_product_deal_total WHERE ps in ('C7','C9') AND finprod_type2 = 'F16' AND trade_status = '01' AND (is_cancel = 'N' OR is_cancel IS NULL) and finprod_id = #{finprodId} ) t where t.ro = 1
